about: Astro Packs: Jake Schincariol's MIT-licensed skill repos, adapted for A.S.T.R.O AI by tools/port_packs.js. Each pack keeps the original MIT notice. Python helpers are re-written in C++ and built into the A.S.T.R.O AI engine (packtools/), or as standard-library Node.js (.mjs) where not yet moved.
author: Jake Schincariol

packs.name: YouTube Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts with scored hooks, titles and packaging, chapters, retention and dead-air analysis, Shorts, SEO, comments and a weekly plan.

packs.name: Instagram Pack
packs.summary: 13 skills for Instagram: reels with hook scoring and beats, captions, carousels, stories, comments, DMs, replies, profile audit, repurposing, a plain-voice style editor and a weekly plan.

packs.name: LinkedIn Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills for LinkedIn: posts from 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, DMs, inbox triage, carousels, a scored profile audit, repurposing, a plain-voice style editor and a weekly plan.

packs.name: X Pack
packs.caveats: Two helpers go online, with no login and no keys: the x-viral/pull tool reads public posts you chose through X's documented embed endpoint (one per second, capped per run, it never crawls or searches), and the x-plan/weights tool reads X's public ranking file on GitHub. Everything else runs offline.
packs.summary: 11 skills that run an X account: posts, threads, replies, comments, DMs, profile, repurposing, a plain-voice style editor, a weekly plan and a virality study of what works in your niche.

packs.name: Founder Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills that test a business before you launch it: board review, CFO unit economics, pricing, offer, competitors, consumer interviews, brand, marketing, ops, plan and launch.

packs.name: Replica Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills that study an app's features and help you build your OWN original product in that space: recon, architecture, design tokens with contrast checks, build, backend, tests, visual diff, deploy and launch.
packs.caveats: Build an original product. Do not copy another company's name, logo, artwork, text, code or private APIs, and respect trademarks, copyright and terms of service. The brand sweep exists to make sure nothing of theirs ships.

packs.name: Arena
packs.summary: When an answer isn't good enough: many sub-agents solve the same task with different strategy cards, then attack, defend and are judged in a single-elimination bracket until one solution survives. Uses A.S.T.R.O AI's task tool (capped to your budget).

packs.name: Duel
packs.summary: Make an answer defend itself against a second model: a critic model challenges it, the agent defends or revises claim by claim, up to three rounds, with a record of what changed.

packs.name: Job Hunter Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills that help you land a job: scout listings, tailor your resume and cover letter, research the company, LinkedIn and networking, applications, interview prep, salary negotiation, follow-ups and a tracker.

packs.name: Trader Pack
packs.summary: 11 investing research skills from public data (SEC EDGAR 13F filings, House disclosures, news): copy an investor's portfolio, watch news and Congress, size trades to your budget, risk, rebalancing and tax lots.
packs.caveats: Research and education only, not financial advice. Markets carry risk of loss and nothing here guarantees returns. The agent must never place, change or cancel an order without your explicit yes in the chat for that exact order; start with paper trading.

packs.name: Day Trader Pack
packs.summary: 11 day-trading research skills from free public data (Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq symbol lists, SEC, House): chart scanner, news, entries and exits, budget, risk, broker tickets and a time machine that replays outcomes.
packs.caveats: Research and education only, not financial advice. Day trading is high risk and most day traders lose money; nothing here guarantees returns. The agent must never place, change or cancel an order without your explicit yes in the chat for that exact order; replay and paper trade first.

packs.name: Master Pack
packs.summary: 3 big skills: Edit (cut dead space, captions, dynamic visuals and stop motion with ffmpeg), Virality (find what works and rewrite it in your voice) and Build (design and code a site with contrast and quality checks).

packs.name: Console Pack
packs.summary: 11 skills to port PlayStation 2 games you own to PC with the open-source PS2Recomp recompiler: reverse engineering, graphics, sound, physics, saves, controllers, levels, testing, mods and builds for other platforms.
packs.caveats: Only for games you own, using your own disc dumps and your own console's BIOS. Astro will not download, share or help find ROMs, ISOs or BIOS files, and will not help bypass copy protection. Respect the game publisher's rights when sharing mods.

packs.name: Work Modes
packs.summary: 25 one-word working modes for the agent: deep-rigor, minimal-diff, fix-all-errors, incident, distill, cost-cutter, build-plan, idea-storm, speedrun, long-haul and more. Plain prompt modes, no scripts.

packs.name: Power Modes
packs.summary: 5 power modes: tournament (six strategies plus a judge), design-polish (anti-slop design audit), compress-prompts (shorter sub-agent briefs), self-critic (attack every claim before it ships) and idea-teardown (startup idea analysis).

packs.name: Promptmaster
packs.summary: Rewrites a vague request into a clear, complete prompt the first time, so you don't burn turns re-explaining. Includes a list of common waste patterns.

packs.name: Closer Pack
packs.caveats: The tools never send anything. Each email, proposal or agreement goes out only after your own yes for that one message (as a Gmail draft you send, or through a Gmail MCP server you added), and the log steps refuse anything else. Two helpers go online with no login or keys: prospector/leads reads one public page per business website, slowly and identifying itself, and researcher/brief reads up to 4 public pages of one business. Cold email has to follow the law where you send it: in the US (CAN-SPAM) every email needs your postal address and a plain opt-out, which the opener's footer adds; in the UK, EU and Canada cold email to people needs a lawful basis or consent first. Anyone who says no goes on the suppression list and is never emailed again.
packs.summary: 11 skills that run a small sales team: find and rank leads, cold openers, follow-ups, a research brief before each call, booking calls, live call coaching from captions, proposals, contracts, win-backs, a deal pipeline and a monthly forecast.

packs.name: Seed Pack
packs.caveats: No promise of funding: the tools draft, research and do arithmetic, and investors decide. The tools never send anything: seed-closer writes drafts, and a batch goes out only after your own yes in the chat (through a Gmail MCP server you added, or as drafts you send yourself). Two helpers go online with no login or keys: seed-scout reads the App Store's public search and review feeds, and seed-investors searches SEC EDGAR Form D filings, which asks every request to say who is asking (sec_user_agent in seed/config.json). Not legal advice: have a startup lawyer read any SAFE or term sheet before you sign it. Not investment advice: the model and the market size are only as good as your assumptions. Cold email has to follow the law where you send it; every email carries your real name, your postal address and an opt-out, and a no, an opt-out or a bounce ends that thread for good.
packs.summary: 11 skills that take a startup from idea to funded: competitor research from one-star reviews, market sizing, investor matching from public sources and SEC filings, a business plan, a financial model, a pitch deck, investor updates, call coaching, a term-sheet reader, a data room, and a closer that drafts investor emails and books the calls.
